artworks.title: L'Absinthe!
artworks.medium: lithograph on chine collé
artworks.creditLine: Given by Art Information Volunteers and Friends in Honor of Christopher B. With
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring skeletons and distressed people. A ghostly figure in white hovers in a chaotic street setting. In the foreground, individuals are collapsed, with one on the ground and another holding a crucifix. Skulls are shown, one being used as a pouring vessel. The backdrop includes an alleyway with fading walls, and a figure seems to be falling off a building. Shadows and texture contribute to the unease, along with the somber appearances of the individuals.

artworks.title: A Landscape (Un Paysage)
artworks.medium: etching on old green laid paper  [proof]
artworks.creditLine: Given by Art Information Volunteers and Friends in Honor of Christopher B. With
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a figure looking out over a landscape. There is a figure close to us, partially hidden by drapery and surrounded by foliage and flowers. The scene includes various textures in the natural elements and fabric. In the distance, there is a pastoral scene with a path, a small figure, and a horse. The horizon line is towards the upper third of the image, with a softly rendered sky. The etching uses cross-hatching and stippling to create a monochromatic palette that emphasizes the contrasts in the scene.

artworks.title: Zacharie Astruc
artworks.medium: etching [proof before letters]
artworks.creditLine: Given by Art Information Volunteers and Friends in Honor of Christopher B. With
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body portrait of a man sitting facing the viewer directly. His head and shoulders are visible. He has a full beard and mustache, and his hair is wavy and falls around his ears. His facial expression is calm and neutral. The man wears a long-sleeved shirt and a loosely arranged tie around his neck. No jewelry is visible, and he is not holding any objects. The background is plain with a simple texture, offering no additional context. The image is presented in a sketch-like style with detailed line work emphasizing the man's face and clothing contours.

artworks.title: Putti Preparing the Interior Decoration of a Mansion
artworks.medium: etching [proof] on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of cherubs engaged in artistic and architectural activities within an ornate interior. The top of the image shows detailed linework of a rococo-style setting with cherubic figures involved in creative pursuits. Some cherubs are at a table with a compass and paper, while another climbs a ladder and one holds a palette. The bottom portion is mostly empty, aside from a decorative letter "S" with small cherubic figures.

artworks.title: Travelers on a Forest Road in a Storm
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a path winding through a forest. Large trees dominate the scene, reaching towards the sky. The style shows detailed etching and fine lines, creating texture in the foliage and tree bark. The color palette is monochrome in shades of black and white. Tree trunks line the foreground, while the path leads deeper into the forest where two figures are visible. The sky is overcast with clouds above the treetops.

artworks.title: A Dragoon on Horseback
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body view of a person on horseback. The person is seated sideways on the rearing horse, positioned in profile view, with one arm raised and pointing. The person has facial features and is wearing a fur hat, a long coat, knee-high boots, and a crossbelt with a sword attached. Next to them are long, strap-like objects. The horse is captured in movement, with its front legs rearing up and its mane flowing backward. The background consists of swirling lines and shading.

artworks.title: Untitled
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image displays an urban scene from an aerial viewpoint, showcasing a cityscape with rooftops and tall buildings. Various rooftops, small structures, and chimneys are portrayed with textured brushstrokes. In the distance, skyscrapers stand out against the sky. The artwork is monochromatic with shades of black and grey, offering a gritty atmosphere and accentuating building details. Additional buildings in the background appear faded, merging with the sky.

artworks.title: Modern Music
artworks.medium: linocut
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene in a public transportation vehicle. The image is created in an expressionist style, showing a crowd of figures inside what appears to be a train or subway car. The composition is dense and dynamic, with strong black and white contrasts and angular lines dominating the visual narrative. Advertisements are shown above the passengers, with text including phrases like "EMERGENCY MEN" and "GIVE THEM TOILET ISSUES." Through the windows, a stylized cityscape can be seen, with rays breaking through the urban setting. The scene feels bustling and crowded, conveying a sense of motion and tension characteristic of life in an industrialized city.

artworks.title: Forest with Travelers by a Road
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This image depicts a woodland scene with a horizon in the upper third of the composition. The artwork uses detailed lines to depict trees and foliage, with mature trees near the foreground and people seated on a small rise in the background. The color palette is predominantly monochrome, with shades of black and gray.

artworks.title: Fränzi Reclining
artworks.medium: black crayon on wove yellow paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch of a woman lying face down with her arms extended forward and her legs stretched out behind her. Her head is turned slightly towards the viewer. The woman's facial features are suggested with simple lines, including her eyes and mouth. She has long hair. The sketch does not include specific clothing details. The background is a plain, light-colored surface.

artworks.title: Mountain Stream
artworks.medium: crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a line drawing with a slightly elevated point of view, looking down at an arrangement of rocks and vegetation. The horizon is not clearly defined, focusing on the rocks stretching towards the edge of the image. The drawing has fluid and curvilinear lines capturing the texture and form of the rocks and plants. The color palette is monochromatic with black lines on a light, cream-colored paper, emphasizing contrasts and contours. The lines vary in intensity, providing depth and dimension, with some areas featuring denser cross-hatching for shadow or texture. Small plant details in the distance suggest subtle growth amidst the rocky terrain.

artworks.title: Ganymede
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over black crayon
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with a winged creature. The artwork depicts a figure riding a large, winged creature. The creature has outstretched wings, and the figure is holding onto its mane or neck. Below them are two other figures, one holding a staff or rod. The scene is drawn in a sketchy and dynamic style with emphasis on movement and form. The background is mostly blank, emphasizing the main subjects. The lines are precise.

artworks.title: Draped Figure with a Staff
artworks.medium: pen and iron gall ink with gray wash over black chalk
artworks.description: The image displays a full-body sketch of a person standing. The person is positioned slightly turned to the left, with their hands clasped together at the waist. The facial features lack detail, and the person has short hair. They wear a long draped garment, possibly a robe or cloak, creating a layered look. The sketch is done in ink and possibly graphite on textured paper, showing preliminary lines and shading. There is no visible jewelry, and the person is not holding any objects. The background is plain, consisting of the textured paper, with a faint outline of a second figure drawn to the left.

artworks.title: A Young Priest Kneeling
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white chalk on blue-gray wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a kneeling position, with their left arm extended forward and their right arm bent. They are wearing a hooded robe that covers their head and body. The sketch is detailed, showing the texture and shading of the fabric. The person's face is visible, slightly tilted upwards. There are no visible accessories or objects, and the background is plain, emphasizing the person's posture.

artworks.title: An Architectural Study with an Atlantid
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash
artworks.description: The image displays swirling lines and curves intersecting with vertical and horizontal strokes in an abstract design. Some lines are reminiscent of architectural columns or scrolls, while others may suggest a human figure or rising plume of smoke. The forms blend into an intricate pattern resembling decorative motifs or fantastical landscapes.

artworks.title: A Gathering in an Interior; A Curtained Doorway
artworks.medium: graphite with stumping on wove paper, with the second drawing in graphite pasted sideways at the bottom of the sheet
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene with a chandelier and a table setting. The drawing is done with loose and quick pencil strokes, depicting the interior of a room adorned with an ornate chandelier hanging from the ceiling in the center. Below the chandelier, there is a sketchy representation of a table with vague outlines of chairs around it, suggesting the presence of furniture in a dining area. The background details, like the room's architecture and decor, are implied with delicate lines. Additionally, there is a smaller rectangle at the bottom with abstract motifs and scribbles, creating an interesting texture. The overall composition is light, with a focus on capturing the essence of the space rather than detailed realism.

artworks.title: Venus and Cupid
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch showing two figures depicted with cross-hatched lines. The figures are lying down, with one on their side and the other reclining against them. Facial features are suggested with simple lines, and both figures have curly hair. There are no specific clothing details or visible accessories. The background is plain and the paper shows signs of aging with slight discolorations and wear.

artworks.title: Charioteers
artworks.medium: pen and purple-black ink on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures and horses in motion. The image features overlapping lines that create a dynamic and chaotic setting. The figures are shown in motion, possibly in a battle or procession. The sketchy style and fluid strokes convey movement and energy. Larger figures are prominently featured in the center, with details becoming more abstract towards the edges, creating depth and perspective.

artworks.title: Ancient Sacrifice and Head of a Satyr
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and violet-brown wash on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a sacrificial scene and a sculptural face. The scene depicted includes several robed figures standing in front of a temple-like structure with columns. A muscular figure is handling a bull by its horns, portraying a sacrificial offering. An altar with burning incense is shown, and on the right side, there is a prominent sculpted face with exaggerated features. The drawing is done with precise lines and shading.

artworks.title: A Seated Nude Man Pointing to the Right
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a seated person, drawn from head to toe in a reclined pose. The individual is leaning back with the upper body turned slightly to the left, while the right arm is extended forward and upward, pointing with the index finger. The figure's head is slightly tilted downward, with curly hair drawn with light strokes. The facial features are expressive yet subtle, outlined eyes, nose, and mouth. The person appears unclothed, with detailed musculature and no visible jewelry or object in their hand. The sketch is on a textured beige background, with a plain background and a handwritten notation "D29330" at the bottom right.

artworks.title: Studies of Figures and Heads
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image features a collection of caricature sketches showing individuals in various poses. The sketches include profiles, three-quarter views, and partial upper bodies. The sketches depict people with exaggerated features like prominent noses and chins. The individuals in the sketches vary in age, expression, and style of hair. Some sketches show people holding props like a cane or wearing distinct accessories like hats. The background of the image is plain with no identifiable objects or scenery.

artworks.title: Studies of a Sower (Illustration for Thomson's _Seasons_)
artworks.medium: graphite and pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch with several figures drawn from head to toe. The central figure on the left is in a walking stance, facing right. The figure has minimal facial features and hair details. It shows a nude male form with emphasis on musculature. An additional figure on the right mirrors the left one. Surrounding sketches depict profiles and partial postures. No jewelry or objects are visible in the figures' hands. The background is plain, focusing on the sketches. Other human forms are faintly outlined on the paper.

artworks.title: Louise Albertine de Brandt, Baroness von Grapendorf
artworks.artist: Georg Friedrich Schmidt, after Pierre Le Sueur
artworks.medium: engraving with etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a composition with four main figures and various objects. A female figure is prominently shown, seated and holding a floral garland while gazing to the side. Next to her is a portrait of another woman, encircled by flowers. An older male figure with wings writes on a tablet, and a cherubic child sits nearby with a book. In the background, there is a classical architectural structure with columns and trees. Surrounding elements include classical musical instruments and a burning urn.

artworks.title: Venus and Cupid on a Dolphin
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in black and white on blue paper
artworks.creditLine: Katharine Shepard Fund and Robison Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a full view of a nude woman reclining on a bed of flowing fabric with a child. The woman has one arm raised above her head, resting against her hair, while the other arm cradles the child who leans against her body. The woman has soft facial features, gently closed eyes, and long hair cascading down her back. The child has curly hair and a calm expression. There are no jewelry or objects in the image. The background is textured and neutral, and the artwork is enclosed within a rectangular frame with an ornate presentation.
